RECEIVED = os.path.join(BASE, "received")
STAGING = os.path.join(BASE, ".staging")
MAX_BODY = 65536

        except OSError:
            pass

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"
    server_version = "LegacyUpload/1.0"

    def setup(self):
        super().setup()
        self.connection.settimeout(15)

    def _reply(self, code, body=b""):
        self.send_response(code)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/plain")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.send_header("Connection", "close")
        self.end_headers()
        if body:
            try:
                self.wfile.write(body)
            except (BrokenPipeError, ConnectionResetError, socket.timeout):
                pass
        self.close_connection = True

    def _read_content_length(self, out_file, length):
        remaining = length
        while remaining:
            block = self.rfile.read(min(65536, remaining))
            if not block:
                return False, 400
            out_file.write(block)
            remaining -= len(block)
        return True, 200

    def _read_chunked(self, out_file):
        total = 0
        while True:
            line = self.rfile.readline(8192)
            if not line or len(line) >= 8192:
                return False, 400
            try:
                size = int(line.split(b";", 1)[0].strip(), 16)
            except ValueError:
                return False, 400
            if size < 0:
                return False, 400
            if size == 0:
                while True:
                    trailer = self.rfile.readline(8192)
                    if not trailer or trailer in (b"\r\n", b"\n"):
                        break
                return True, 200
            if total + size > MAX_BODY:
                return False, 413
            data = self.rfile.read(size)
            if len(data) != size:
                return False, 400
            ending = self.rfile.read(2)
            if ending != b"\r\n":
                return False, 400
            out_file.write(data)
            total += size

    def do_POST(self):
        if self.path != "/upload":
            self._reply(404, b"not found\n")
            return

        transfer_encoding = self.headers.get("Transfer-Encoding", "").lower().strip()
        content_length = self.headers.get("Content-Length")
        chunked = transfer_encoding == "chunked"
        if transfer_encoding and not chunked:
            self._reply(400, b"unsupported transfer encoding\n")
            return
        if chunked and content_length is not None:
            self._reply(400, b"ambiguous body framing\n")
            return

        length = 0
        if not chunked and content_length is not None:
            try:
                length = int(content_length, 10)
            except ValueError:
                self._reply(400, b"invalid content length\n")
                return
            if length < 0:
                self._reply(400, b"invalid content length\n")
                return
            if length > MAX_BODY:
                self._reply(413, b"payload too large\n")
                return

        fd, temp_path = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix="upload-", suffix=".part", dir=STAGING)
        published = False
        try:
            with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as out_file:
                if chunked:
                    complete, status = self._read_chunked(out_file)
                else:
                    complete, status = self._read_content_length(out_file, length)
                if not complete:
                    if status == 413:
                        self._reply(413, b"payload too large\n")
                    elif status == 400:
                        self._reply(400, b"incomplete or invalid body\n")
                    return
                out_file.flush()
                os.fsync(out_file.fileno())

            receipt = "upload-" + uuid.uuid4().hex + ".bin"
            final_path = os.path.join(RECEIVED, receipt)
            os.replace(temp_path, final_path)
            published = True
            dir_fd = os.open(RECEIVED, os.O_RDONLY)
            try:
                os.fsync(dir_fd)
            finally:
                os.close(dir_fd)
            self._reply(200, (receipt + "\n").encode("ascii"))
        except (ConnectionError, socket.timeout):
            return
        finally:
            if not published:
                try:
                    os.unlink(temp_path)
                except FileNotFoundError:
                    pass

    def _not_found(self):
        self._reply(404, b"not found\n")

    do_GET = _not_found
    do_HEAD = _not_found
    do_PUT = _not_found
    do_DELETE = _not_found
    do_PATCH = _not_found

    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        print("%s - - [%s] %s" % (self.client_address[0], self.log_date_time_string(), fmt % args), flush=True)

class Server(ThreadingHTTPServer):
    daemon_threads = True
    allow_reuse_address = True

Server(("0.0.0.0", 8080), Handler).serve_forever()
